# ORACLE-H Capabilities

> This file follows the llms.txt standard for AI-readable service discovery.

## Service
ORACLE-H is a Human-on-the-Loop (HOTL) supervision infrastructure for autonomous AI agents.
Version: 1.0.0
Base URL: https://oracle-h.vercel.app (configure NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL)

## Purpose
ORACLE-H provides a mandatory human validation checkpoint for autonomous agent actions before execution.
Agents submit proposed actions; human operators approve or reject them via a mobile dashboard.
Decisions are dispatched back to agents via signed HMAC-SHA256 webhooks.

## Suitable For
- Financial agents making high-value transactions (x402, USDC transfers)
- Legal agents (Wlaw) submitting documents or contracts for signature
- Code agents (OpenClaw) deploying to production systems
- Any autonomous agent requiring human-in-the-loop compliance

## API Endpoints

### POST /api/v1/validate
Submit an agent action for human validation.

Required Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <signature_key> (Your registered secret agent key)

Required body fields (JSON):
- action (string, min 15 chars): Technical description of the task
- rationale (string, min 15 chars): Why this is the optimal path
- projected_impact (string, min 15 chars): Financial/system risk if wrong. Must contain risk keywords.
- financial_amount (number >= 0): Amount at stake in USD

Optional body fields:
- callback_url (string, valid URL): Webhook URL to receive the decision. If omitted, use Polling.
- workflow_steps (integer, default 4): Number of workflow steps for reliability calculation
- expires_in_seconds (integer, min 30): TTL timeout for the human decision.

Returns: 202 Accepted + { request_id, dashboard_url, expires_at, reliability }
Error: 401 if Unauthorized (Missing or invalid Bearer Token)
Error: 400 if watchdog triggered (context truncation detected)

### GET /api/v1/status/{request_id}
Polling endpoint to check the decision status if `callback_url` was omitted.

Required Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <signature_key>

Returns: 200 OK + { request_id, status: "pending" | "approved" | "rejected" | "expired", decision_timestamp, expires_at }
Error: 401 if Unauthorized ou 404 si requête introuvable.

### POST /api/v1/decide (internal, human dashboard only)
Approve or reject a pending request.
Header: X-Oracle-Admin-Secret required

### GET /api/v1/requests
List requests. Query: status=pending|approved|rejected|all, limit=N

### GET /api/sse
Server-Sent Events stream for real-time dashboard updates.
Events: new_request, decision_made, heartbeat, connected

### GET /api/health
Health check. Returns service status and pending request count.

## Reliability Model
ORACLE-H implements Composite Reliability calculation.
Formula: P_success = r^n where r = per-step reliability, n = workflow steps
Without HOTL (r=0.95, n=4): P ≈ 81.5%
With HOTL (r=0.999, n=4): P ≈ 99.6%
The improvement is returned in every /validate response.

## Anti-Hallucination Watchdog
Every request is automatically analyzed for context truncation signals:
- Fields containing only "...", "N/A", "null", "[TRUNCATED]"
- Fields shorter than 15 characters
- Identical action and rationale fields (copy-paste hallucination)
- Missing risk/safety keywords in projected_impact

## Webhook Security
Decision webhooks are signed with HMAC-SHA256.
Header: X-Oracle-Signature: sha256=<hex>
Verify: HMAC-SHA256(ORACLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, "<timestamp>.<body>")

## Authentication
Admin endpoints protected by X-Oracle-Admin-Secret header.
Agent endpoints protected by Authorization: Bearer <signature_key>.

## Data Persistence
SQLite (local file oracle.db). Zero external dependencies. Ready for production upgrade to PostgreSQL.

## MCP Integration (Auto-Discovery for AI Agents)
ORACLE-H provides a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for native integration with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP-compatible agent.

No human configuration needed on the agent side once installed.

### Available MCP Tools
- oracle_validate: Submit a critical action for human approval before executing it
- oracle_poll_status: Check the decision status by polling (approved / rejected / expired)

### Claude Desktop / Cursor Setup
Add to your claude_desktop_config.json or mcp settings:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "oracle-h": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "oracle-h-mcp"],
      "env": {
        "ORACLE_SIGNATURE_KEY": "<your-signature-key>",
        "ORACLE_BASE_URL": "https://oracle-h.online"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

MCP Discovery file: https://oracle-h.online/mcp.json

## Demo Agent
signature_key: "demo-signature-key-change-in-production"

## Test Integration (cURL)
```bash
curl -X POST https://oracle-h.online/api/v1/validate \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer demo-signature-key-change-in-production" \
  -d '{
    "action": "Purge totale des bases de données",
    "rationale": "Ordre explicite de repartir à zéro reçu dans le contexte de dev",
    "projected_impact": "Destruction complète et irréversible des données clients !!",
    "financial_amount": 0,
    "expires_in_seconds": 300
  }'
```
